basics.name: Pavel Golikov
basics.label: AI Researcher & Agent Engineer
basics.summary: AI researcher and agent engineer specializing in robust machine reasoning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), LLM evaluation, and alignment. Builds grounded agentic workflows, vector-retrieval systems, and dataset generators for context-management evaluation in LLM agents.

work.summary: EcoSystem research group; member of the Vector Institute.
highlights: Researches robust machine reasoning, agent evaluation, context management, and AI alignment.
Builds open-source agentic systems, RAG pipelines, and dataset generators for context-management evaluation; conducts mechanistic-interpretability analyses.

work.summary: Built a distributed IoT streaming framework spanning edge devices and cloud infrastructure.
highlights: Programmed Arduino/C++ sensors, Python services, socket networking, AWS infrastructure, and Apache Flink pipelines.

work.summary: Analyzed classified information streams and formerly held a Top Secret security clearance.
highlights: Developed an adversarial threat-modeling mindset centered on operational security, evidence quality, and rigorous validation.

education.area: PhD in Computer Science (paused to transition to industry)
Master of Science in Computer Science
Bachelor of Science in Mathematics and Philosophy (Formal Logic)
